faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - I positions is 30-08-2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MSc degree in Marine Science, Oceanography, or Physical Oceanography to be eligible for the Project Associate - I position at CSIR NIO.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate - I position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Project Associate - I post announced by CSIR - National Institute of Oceanography (CSIR NIO) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate - I role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Project Associate - I position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, according to the notification, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - I posts?
faq.answer: The application process for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - I recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official CSIR NIO website.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The positions of Project Associate - I are contractual in nature. This means the employment is for a fixed tenure as per the project requirements.

faq.question: Q8. Where is CSIR NIO located?
faq.answer: CSIR NIO is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra. The recruitment notification specifies the location as Mumbai, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment of Project Associate - I posts at CSIR NIO is SSP3611/3289-26.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from any state apply for this job?
faq.answer: While the job is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra, the notification does not specify any state-wise restrictions for applicants. Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria from across India can apply.
